content_en.title: Villa Rental Booking Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a villa rental agency with 143 villas around Puncak and Cipanas. Guests search by location, dates and group size, see which villas are still free, and pay the down payment from the villa page instead of checking availability over WhatsApp.
content_en.challenge:
The agency manages villas from two to forty-two bedrooms, but the old site opened with a default store list sorted by popularity, with no date or guest search. Listing cards did not show bedrooms or capacity, and every villa page ended in a single WhatsApp button, so guests had to ask about each villa's availability one chat at a time.

Important terms were spread across separate pages: down payments of 30 or 50 percent depending on the season, extra-bed and catering prices, survey fees, and a list of six bank accounts to transfer to, which made it harder for guests to trust where to pay.
content_en.solution:
The homepage leads with a search for location, dates and guests, location chips with villa counts, villas still free for the coming weekend, and shortcuts by group size for families, reunions and company gatherings. Search results filter by bedrooms, price and facilities, show availability for the chosen dates, and flag villas that need extra beds.

Each villa page combines the gallery, facilities, add-ons and payment rules with an availability calendar that shows weekday and weekend prices. Changing the guest count or adding catering updates the total and the 30 percent down payment, which is paid to a virtual account on the invoice. An agent dashboard shows occupancy per villa by day, pending down payments that are released automatically, and scheduled villa surveys. The planned production stack is Next.js with Supabase and a payment gateway.
features: Location, date and guest search with villa counts per area
Shortcuts by group size for families, reunions and company gatherings
Search results filtered by availability, bedrooms, price and facilities
Availability calendar with weekday and weekend prices
Live total with extra beds, catering and the down payment
Down payment by virtual account with automatic release on expiry
Agent dashboard for occupancy, pending payments and survey schedules

content_id.title: Website Booking Sewa Villa
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk agen sewa villa dengan 143 villa di Puncak dan Cipanas. Tamu mencari berdasarkan lokasi, tanggal, dan jumlah orang, melihat villa yang masih kosong, lalu membayar DP dari halaman villa tanpa menanyakan ketersediaan lewat WhatsApp.
content_id.challenge:
Agen ini mengelola villa dari dua sampai empat puluh dua kamar, tetapi situs lama dibuka dengan daftar toko standar yang diurutkan berdasarkan popularitas, tanpa pencarian tanggal maupun jumlah tamu. Kartu villa tidak menampilkan jumlah kamar atau kapasitas, dan setiap halaman villa berakhir di satu tombol WhatsApp, sehingga tamu harus menanyakan ketersediaan villa satu per satu lewat chat.

Ketentuan penting tersebar di halaman terpisah: DP 30 atau 50 persen tergantung musim, harga extra bed dan catering, biaya survey, serta daftar enam rekening bank tujuan transfer, yang membuat tamu ragu ke mana harus membayar.
content_id.solution:
Beranda dibuka dengan pencarian lokasi, tanggal, dan tamu, chip lokasi beserta jumlah villa, villa yang masih kosong untuk akhir pekan terdekat, serta pintasan berdasarkan ukuran rombongan untuk keluarga, reuni, dan gathering kantor. Hasil pencarian bisa difilter berdasarkan kamar, harga, dan fasilitas, menampilkan ketersediaan untuk tanggal yang dipilih, dan menandai villa yang membutuhkan extra bed.

Setiap halaman villa menggabungkan galeri, fasilitas, tambahan, dan aturan pembayaran dengan kalender ketersediaan yang menunjukkan harga weekday dan weekend. Mengubah jumlah tamu atau menambah catering langsung memperbarui total dan DP 30 persen, yang dibayar ke virtual account di invoice. Dashboard agen menampilkan okupansi tiap villa per hari, DP yang menunggu dan dilepas otomatis, serta jadwal survey villa. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Next.js dengan Supabase dan payment gateway.
features: Pencarian lokasi, tanggal, dan tamu dengan jumlah villa per area
Pintasan berdasarkan ukuran rombongan: keluarga, reuni, gathering kantor
Hasil pencarian dengan filter ketersediaan, kamar, harga, dan fasilitas
Kalender ketersediaan dengan harga weekday dan weekend
Total langsung dengan extra bed, catering, dan DP
DP lewat virtual account dengan pelepasan otomatis saat kedaluwarsa
Dashboard agen untuk okupansi, DP tertunda, dan jadwal survey
